tracks.name: RoboTwin-Phys v1 · physical-condition robustness
tracks.protocol: Clean disables benchmark randomization; Official Random enables original visual/layout randomization; Physical Random additionally samples 13 physical attributes. Physical Random is evaluated by the paper.
tracks.trainingRegime: Evaluated released WAM/VLA policies; Clean and Official Random are corresponding public benchmark results, Physical Random is the new paper evaluation.

results.trainingData: Released model/checkpoint evaluated under RoboTwin-family protocols; original training data and recipes differ across methods.
results.evaluationNotes: Clean and Official Random are corresponding public benchmark results summarized by the paper; Physical Random is evaluated under the new 13-attribute protocol. Do not interpret rows as equal-training causal comparison.
